steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Ballet originated in the courts of Renaissance Italy and France in the 15th and 16th centuries

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: King Louis XIV of France established the Académie Royale de Danse in 1661, professionalising ballet

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Romantic ballet emerged in the 1830s with ethereal themes and pointe work, such as La Sylphide

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Classical ballet peaked in late 19th-century Russia with works like Swan Lake and The Sleeping Beauty

steps.title: Try it yourself

steps.title: Exam tips
steps.body: When discussing dance history, always link the period or figure to a specific professional work you have studied Use precise dates and names — examiners reward accurate historical knowledge Explain how historical developments influenced choreographic style, not just what happened Compare at least two different periods or choreographers when asked about dance evolution Remember that dance history questions often require you to analyse, not just describe
